Owner login → /dashboard renders digest-widget (below compliance inbox) and nav-admin-demos sidebar link; /dashboard/admin/demos renders admin-demos-page with 12 stat-card testids and populated list. _owner_only() uses getattr(user, 'role_variant', 'owner') — note that if the attribute is missing it defaults to 'owner', so any future non-User current_user shape could accidentally permit access. Safer default is 'worker' or require explicit variant. Low risk in current setup (User model always has role_variant).
